mapper.select: SELECT id FROM user_accounts WHERE id=#{owner} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_resumes(user_id,updated_at) VALUES(#{owner},#{now}) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_resumes WHERE user_id=#{owner} FOR UPDATE
SELECT o.* FROM user_resumes r JOIN resume_objects o ON o.user_id=r.user_id AND o.id=r.current_object_id WHERE r.user_id=#{owner} AND r.source_kind='MD_FILE' AND o.status='READY'
SELECT * FROM resume_objects WHERE user_id=#{owner} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM resume_objects WHERE user_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM resume_write_receipts WHERE user_id=#{owner} AND operation=#{operation} AND request_id=#{request}
mapper.update: UPDATE resume_objects SET status=#{status},safe_failure_code=#{code},updated_at=#{now}, original_filename=CASE WHEN #{status}='DELETED' THEN NULL ELSE original_filename END WHERE user_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND status=#{oldStatus} AND operation_token=#{token} AND (#{status}!='READY' OR lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp())
UPDATE resume_write_receipts SET state=#{state},result_version=#{version},safe_failure_code=#{code} WHERE user_id=#{owner} AND operation='IMPORT' AND request_id=#{request} AND state='UPLOADING'

UPDATE resume_objects SET io_uncertain=FALSE,cleanup_after=#{now},updated_at=#{now}, status=CASE WHEN status IN ('DELETED','DELETING') THEN 'DELETE_FAILED' ELSE status END, safe_failure_code=CASE WHEN status IN ('DELETED','DELETING') THEN 'LATE_UPLOAD_CLEANUP' ELSE safe_failure_code END WHERE user_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND upload_token=#{uploadToken}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM resume_objects WHERE status IN ('UPLOADING','FAILED','DELETING','DELETE_FAILED') OR io_uncertain OR (status='READY' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_resumes r WHERE r.user_id=resume_objects.user_id AND r.current_object_id=resume_objects.id))
